Oneliner

Test deployment of 1 x 1.5m membrane for deorbiting.
Description

Membrane deployment orbit experiments. The satellite will deploy the DOM1500 device, which will form a 1 m by 1.5 m membrane to increase the aerodynamic resistance to accelerate the decay from orbit.
